name: Nahdi Medical Company
summary: Nahdi Medical Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the wholesale and retail trading of cosmetics, pharmaceutical, special and healthy foods, and medical equipment products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. The company also offers mom and baby, beauty, and everyday essentials through retail and online stores. In addition, it operates Nahdi Care polyclinic; and provides virtual care services. Further, the company is involved in operating E-Pharmacist platform; and Nahdi Online, an online pharmacy. Additionally, it provides labor and IT consulting services.
